scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names main,preload,renderer,electron --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,green,magenta "vite build --watch --config vite.main.config.ts" "vite build --watch --config vite.preload.config.ts" "vite --config vite.renderer.config.ts" "wait-on dist/main/main.mjs && electron ."
scripts.build: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts
scripts.package: bun run rebuild && bun run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Run `bun run --filter @imagine-studio/desktop rebuild` before launching the desktop app to rebuild native modules for Electron'
